latest_cos_commentary.headline: Square (Block, Inc.) is a large, publicly traded POS/payments platform whose food-and-beverage segment GPV grew 21% year-over-year in Q1 2026, its strongest growth since 2023, as it pushes upmarket into larger multi-location merchants.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Direct competitor across POS and payments; Square's own investor commentary explicitly names Toast as a restaurant POS/payments competitor, indicating Square is positioning itself in the same competitive set that includes Genius.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Food-and-beverage GPV growth reaccelerated to its strongest pace since 2023, and Square is actively expanding into larger multi-location restaurant/hospitality accounts rather than staying purely in the small independent-restaurant segment.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Expect Square to increasingly appear in larger multi-location restaurant RFPs, not just small independent accounts; be prepared to differentiate Genius on enterprise support, integrated payments depth, and multi-location management rather than assuming Square is only a small-merchant tool.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Public GPV/growth figures are segment-wide (food & beverage), not restaurant-only or Genius-comparable in scope; avoid treating them as a like-for-like market-share comparison.
